rationale: No existing spec covers the profiling flag gating of any entry point. streamsExploreLogsTypePersistence uses the LogStream data-otoggle-value filter (closest sibling selector) but asserts stream-type persistence, not flag gating; ingestion-config covers the Custom tabs but only their copy/onboarding content, never the ingestProfiles tab's presence/absence; landingPage validates nav menus but never the Profiles item. The feature (one flag gating three changed entry points + one pre-existing) needs its own spec in Logs, registered under the Logs-Core shard per run-context playwright_group.
